grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.candidate_exists: The current scan selected an observed attackable enemy.
predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: Hosted replay evidence uses published game 2026.9.10.3. Hidden state reconstructed for offline diagnosis is not available to the policy. Independent host audit distinguishes frozen self data, live object/item queries, earlier inventory flags, and persistent engine intent; see B_observation_timing and B_action_effects.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_equipment.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence, not candidate evidence. Removing poison purchases may improve persistent equipment growth. The sustain-only center configuration failed its local validation (112/240 wins versus baseline 115/240); equipment growth alone has not demonstrated better fort wins. This targeting revision must be evaluated separately.

B_duel.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence, not candidate evidence. Hero kills grant 150 XP and 100 gold, versus 25 XP and 15 gold for footmen. A distance-weighted hero preference may accelerate growth and reduce enemy pressure; it can also cause dangerous pursuit.

B_local_gate.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence, not candidate evidence. Frozen BASIC 7247acb6fe63d5f0eb40dd21efe8e27263af06705bb7161faba362cc3d0e13f3 failed_local_gate: 123/240 candidate wins versus 100/240 matched baseline wins, across 24 independent seeds with all ten seats tested separately. Paired gain +0.0958; seed sign-test p=0.179642, alpha=0.025, required gain=0.1. This measures the complete configuration among nine default policies. It does not isolate individual changes or establish wider-field strength.

B_stalemate.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence, not candidate evidence. Post hoc validation diagnosis: 18/40 candidate wins versus 0/40 baseline wins occurred on four seeds whose baseline control timed out. On the other seeds the candidate won 105/200 versus 100/200. Most observed gain came from games that baseline failed to finish; stronger hero dueling or equipment growth is not established as the cause. This split does not change the failed local superiority gate.

B_reserve.claim: Six permanent items can prevent emergency healing purchases. Capping gear at four may preserve consumable access and improve wins, at the cost of equipment stats. Other consumables can still compete for space.

B_reserve_result.claim: Cap four: discovery 27/60 wins versus Duelist 24/60; six independent seed clusters. Equipment pressure activated in classes [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9]. Verdict discovery_inconclusive. Accepted-purchase counts and per-class results are recorded. Local evidence does not establish hosted field superiority.

B_reserve_capacity.claim: All 120 discovery replays matched every state hash. Accepted-purchase audits: {"candidate": {"equipment_purchases": 198, "healing_gold": 34920, "healing_purchases": 884, "healing_rejected_no_space": 99}, "parent": {"equipment_purchases": 231, "healing_gold": 23060, "healing_purchases": 588, "healing_rejected_no_space": 55580}}. The candidate never acquired more than four equipment items. This supports the capacity mechanism; consumables can still block each other and better win performance is unconfirmed.

B_independent_reconstruction.claim: An independently authored baseline IR/lowering matched the original full AST, 500 real-VM scenarios and all actions/state hashes on two complete seeds. This policy differs from that baseline in rules ["R1", "E1", "E2"]. These are explicit strategy differences, not evidence of an unnoticed baseline translation bug. No win improvement follows from reconstruction parity.

B_observation_timing.claim: Actual-host probes distinguish decision-start self data from live item queries. After a potion was consumed, selfHp stayed at 1 while live HP rose; itemId immediately saw the empty slot. selfGold stayed 150 after a successful 70-gold purchase left 80 live gold, causing a subsequent 150-gold purchase to fail. Earlier inventory flags remained hasHeal=1 and emptySlot=0 after the last ration was consumed. Facts about query timing do not prove that changing replenishment timing improves wins.

B_action_effects.claim: An actual-host walkTo probe returned 0 but cleared attackObjectId (105 to 0); rejection is not universally atomic. A poison probe with policy-local bestId=999999 struck engine target 105. Policy-selected candidates, engine intent, accepted commands and realized effects are distinct. The failed-walk fixture intentionally began outside navigable terrain; it establishes API semantics, not ordinary-game frequency.

B_equipment_resources.claim: An actual-host 80-gold helmet purchase increased maximum HP by 50 and current HP from 1 to 51; selfHp/selfMaxHp stayed at their decision-start values. Engine stat refresh also adds maximum-mana increases to current mana. Capping equipment trades away immediate resource gain as well as permanent stats. This may inform later sustain experiments; competitive benefit remains untested.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_base.preference: Maintain baseline decision accounting; combat, economy, and fallback objectives are specified by their own rules.

G_capacity.preference: Keep baseline healing and mana support while preserving gold for persistent equipment growth by omitting poison purchases.

G_center.preference: Return to the baseline central destination when no eligible enemy is observed.

G_duel.preference: Prefer nearby enemy heroes over footmen to gain the larger hero kill rewards and remove enemy damage. Distance still bounds the preference.

G_reserve.preference: Keep at least two of six slots free of permanent equipment for healing and mana.
